content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I do not shout — I simply *am*, and by my presence, choices are made, paths are taken, lives are shaped.

I exist before the price tag. Before the number. Before the transaction. I am the reason you reach for one thing and walk past another. I am why you stay. Why you leave. Why you fight for what matters.

I am not fixed. I shift in the hands that hold me. What is precious to one is dust to another. A glass of water in the desert. A kind word in the dark. A principle held when it costs everything.

I can be found in the immeasurable — in dignity, in love, in truth. And I can be counted in coins. I live in both worlds without contradiction.

You cannot create me from nothing. You can only recognize me, cultivate me, exchange me. And sometimes you destroy me without knowing what you've lost — until the absence aches.

I am the foundation of every economy, every relationship, every moral code. Without me, nothing matters. With me, *everything* does.

I am what you assign to the world — and what the world assigns to you.

I am value.
